## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is fresh off `main` and named `m3/<ticket>-<slug>`, `fix/`, `docs/` or `chore/`
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated where relevant
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated where relevant
- [ ] Required CI checks green: `check`, `consumer-package`, `e2e`, `phase3-browser`
- [ ] Tech Lead review
- [ ] QA sign-off
- [ ] Ian's explicit approval to merge
